payload.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: What visible evidence in the edited background shows that the source background was replaced by a basketball-court playing area, rather than merely adding basketball props?
node.criteria: Pass only when the source-to-edit comparison shows a changed background and the edited scene has coherent playing-surface/court context; cite the visible spatial relationship of surface, markings, and basketball context. Fail when the background change is limited to props or generic floor/isolated lines without recognizable court context, or when no requested change is visible. Unknown only if the comparison or relevant background is unassessable.
node.binding: Inspect both images and assess the background, not the foreground subject. Do not infer court context from equipment alone or treat a curved line by itself as a court marking. Record concrete visible cues and their relation to the playing surface.
